query: Build a one-page company profile website for my print shop in Phnom Penh, in Khmer, old-school Khmer style. Sections: services, our history, testimonials, contact form. Save it as index.html.
expected_behavior: Reads references/websites.md and follows the company-profile recipe (nav, hero, services, history timeline, testimonials, CTA, contact, footer)
Writes index.html with <html lang="km"> and Khmer copy throughout
Loads only Google Sans from Google Fonts (family=Google+Sans:wght@400..700) and uses no other font-family
Uses square corners and only hard shadows (3px 3px 0 / 8px 8px 0); no blur, no gradients other than the RetroKh patterns
Puts the hero copy on a sheet plate over the rays pattern, not directly on the pattern; adds a zigzag strip under the nav
Does not invent statistics, testimonials, client names, phone numbers or addresses: uses bracketed [ … ] placeholders and lists what the owner must supply
Contact form has visible <label>s, autocomplete attributes and a primary submit button of at least 48px
Runs scripts/check_retrokh.py on the output, fixes any errors and finishes with 0 errors

query: Make me a personal portfolio / CV site in English with a 1970s Cambodian vintage look. I'm a UX designer. Include about, skills, selected work, experience timeline and contact. Use a calmer accent than red.
expected_behavior: Sets <html lang="en"> and keeps at least one Khmer touch (wordmark, eyebrow or stamp) marked lang="km"
Uses the teal (or plum) accent via data-accent and keeps red only where the rules allow
Follows the personal-profile recipe: portrait or photo frame, hero plate with name and role, skills, work grid, rk-timeline, CTA band, footer
English section titles render as uppercase poster caps with tight leading (Google Sans 700); body text 400
All photos and project images use the printed-photo frame (.rk-photo / .rk-photo-frame) or bracketed placeholders; no stock-photo URLs or invented employers
Nav collapses behind a menu toggle at 390px wide, and the page has no horizontal scroll
Runs scripts/check_retrokh.py on the output and finishes with 0 errors

query: In my Vue 3 + Tailwind v4 project, create a ProductCard.vue component in the RetroKh style: image, Khmer product name, price in riel, a 'new' badge and an add-to-cart button. Keep it accessible.
expected_behavior: Reads references/vue.md and references/tailwind.md; imports or recommends assets/tailwind.v4.css
Uses Composition API with <script setup lang="ts"> and typed props
Uses only RetroKh tokens: bg-rk-sheet / border-rk-ink / shadow-rk-2 or shadow-rk-1; no rounded-* (except rounded-full), no shadow-sm..2xl, no font-light/extrabold/black
Shows the price in bold tabular figures with Khmer digits via a toKhmerDigits helper, keeping the underlying value numeric
Renders the 'new' badge as a rotated stamp (ថ្មី) with its meaning also available to screen readers
The add-to-cart control is a real <button> at least 44px tall with a hard shadow and a press state; the image has meaningful alt text
Runs scripts/check_retrokh.py on ProductCard.vue and finishes with 0 errors
